name: Kaikielius
description: Kaikielius was a planet in the Kaikielius system of the Core Worlds. A regional power before the rise of the Republic and a Core Founder, it was situated on the Koros Trunk Line, just outside of the Deep Core. The planet was the homeworld of the influential political dynasty House Praji.
